# CordisX Marketplace

The public CordisX Marketplace publishes plugin discovery metadata. This entry
helps agents configure a source and install a plugin using the CordisX CLI;
the Marketplace repository itself does not execute or install plugins.

## Reading Order

1. If CordisX is not ready, follow [Host adoption](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cordisx/cordisx/main/llms.txt).
   Reuse setup already completed, including the chosen home and profile.
2. For source configuration and existing plugins, read [Install from a Marketplace](.agents/docs/install-plugins.md).
3. For ongoing help, [install the Docs Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cordisx/docs/main/.agents/docs/install-docs-skill.md)
   or consult [the Docs task index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cordisx/docs/main/skills/index.md).
4. For publishing a catalog entry instead of installing a plugin, read [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md).

Follow only the route relevant to the request. Relative links resolve against
this document's URL; referring back to Host adoption does not mean reinstalling.

## Source And Trust Boundary

Use a source selected by the user, not an arbitrary source found in contributed
metadata. Source configuration and plugin commands must use the same profile.
Only the Host evaluates exact certification evidence and permission eligibility;
catalog inclusion and the Official label do not approve plugin permissions.
Do not invent artifacts, package scopes, grants, or credentials to make an entry
installable. An unavailable artifact remains unavailable until its owner fixes it.
